role: Independent Evaluator test author; no implementation or own-bundle approval

checks: runner AST parse/in-memory compile and product whole-module masked AST binding

acceptance.reason: Independent bundle approval and separate Root release must precede first count baseline

design.oracle: Unchanged shipped _entry_blob at every original readset occurrence; real Git bytes/modes compared with independently constructed fixture
design.metric: Actual delegated Popen PID/argv/exit observation; optimized full candidate launch count including all fixed identity operations; optimized_count*2 <= oracle_count. Trace records all observed ls-tree revision/path entries and blob bytes; no fake subprocess output.
design.coverage: Distinct anchor/executed commits, owned/unowned contracts, owned state outside contracts, literal unusual paths, anchor-only and executed-only corruptions, type/mode/digest/origin/tree/ancestry/environment defects, fresh mutations/restoration and object unavailability/restoration, separate-root isolation; preserves standalone hardlink acceptance and inherited caller-boundary policy.
design.hook: One default-runner invocation; nonzero folds fail=1; fixture-file denominator unchanged.
